name: Kano City (KSA-1 master plan): A2 gateway, ring road, middle and wall rings, radial arterials, the modern residential estate D06 and the city fabric

meta.gameCoverage: KANO CITY. The actual city on the master plan's 10 x 10 km frame (KSA-1, docs/KANO_CITY_MASTER_PLAN.md): the A2 into the ring road, the ring road with its roundabouts, the middle ring and the road along the old city wall, the radial arterials, district D06 (the modern residential estate) complete, and the city fabric along every road. Inside the wall nothing is built yet: the old city, Kurmi market and the landmarks wait for proper references. Positions are the plan's (indicative, not survey).
meta.notes: The Kano city route (owner directive 2026-11-16). docs/KANO_CITY.md.
